profile.selection_basis: Largest measured end-to-end stage among write and query medians; NOT an inferred contribution to platform E.

workload.filter: c = category; ten uniformly populated categories; 10% selectivity
workload.transactions: BEGIN + INSERT 100 rows + COMMIT for every batch

scoring.local_document_E_range: (0,1); incompatible with platform value unless a different formula/scale is used

measurement_scope.write_T: End-to-end BEGIN/INSERT/COMMIT requests and complete responses; database fsync semantics unchanged.
measurement_scope.query_T: Sum of two query-group wall times; 1000 requests and complete responses; excludes warmup and observer pauses.
measurement_scope.B_M: Cumulative from new database cgroup creation through startup, schema, loading, index, warmup, queries and settled writeback. Write snapshot stops after writing.
measurement_scope.resource_collection: Separate observer container/cgroup, no docker exec or profiler in measured database cgroups.
measurement_scope.phase_memory: Cumulative memory.peak at each boundary, including file cache; not per-process RSS or differences of peaks.
measurement_scope.cache: Fresh independent volumes/cgroups, fixed 20-query warmup; no global cache drop. Runtime/image cache may be warm.
limitations: Official generator/seed, warmup/cache reset, baseline metrics, dedicated-device configuration and preparation time cap are unknown.
Docker data volume shares a host device; raw per-device cgroup I/O is local evidence, not certified platform B.
No platform E is inferred or computed. Per-metric medians are descriptive, not a synthetic scoring round.
Observer syncfs flushes the containing filesystem; its latency is reported separately and is not assumed to be database-only latency.
